clubEloToTeamQuality.notes: Monotonic ClubElo→internal team quality fitted to percentile anchors over the observed 485-club Elo range so weak and elite clubs are not flattened. Distinct from Opta and FIFA transforms. Parameters frozen with baseline.

optaToTeamQuality.notes: Legacy Opta mapping retained for archived Opta snapshots only; not used for new-career club baselines after team-quality-v3.

fifaPointsToTeamQuality.notes: Monotonic mapping from FIFA ranking points into national team quality. Distinct from club Elo scale.

subratings.notes: Attack/midfield/defence/GK equal the transformed overall when positional evidence is unavailable. Marked derived, never verified provider data.

replacementOvr.notes: Typical replacement player OVR band derived from team quality; not a published observation.

fallback.notes: League-centre priors removed for new careers. Genuine gaps use results_derived or remain unresolved.
